name: Show timeline: layer tracks with presets
description: A track keeps driving its layer when presets swap the layers underneath, a track whose layer is not in the current preset injects its own copy, and a New layer track adds the layer to the presets the show uses.

steps.label: Preset A: both tracked layers play their clips

eval.true.label: Floor is on stage and driven in place

steps.label: Preset B swapped the layers: the Wall track still drives Wall
Preset C has no Floor: the track injects its own copy
The Wall track still plays under preset C

steps.name: fresh
steps.label: + Track, New layer, added to the presets

eval.true.js: (() => { const id = __show.show().layerTracks.find((t) => t.id === __show.vars['track:fresh']).layerId; const used = new Set(__show.show().presetClips.map((c) => c.compositionId)); return [...used].every((cid) => __show.project().vjMode.compositions.find((c) => c.id === cid).layers.some((l) => l.id === id)); })()
eval.true.label: every preset the show uses has the new layer

steps.label: Back in preset A the new layer is on stage and plays its clip

eval.true.label: the new layer is on stage under preset A
